name: ohmyflow
description: MyFlow by DOSS Clone - AI Photo Culler 100% Local, Native Windows
author: OhMyFlow

scripts.build: tsc && vite build && npm run copy:ort
scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:electron && concurrently "vite --host" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron dist-electron/main.js"
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-packager . OhMyFlow --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=release --overwrite --prune --ignore="^/(test-photos|release|dist-electron/electron|src|scripts|public|electron|DIGICAM|FIX KERAMIK|bulbah|Foto OSIS skvela|MEMORY\.md|ARCHITECTURE\.md|PRODUCT\.md|PLAN\.md|fase-update\.md|new-architecture\.md|opencode\.json|\.gitignore|\.gitattributes|tsconfig.*|postcss\.config\.cjs|tailwind\.config\.cjs|vite\.config\.ts)" --icon=build/icon.ico
scripts.pack:legacy: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win --x64
